relations.rationale: Kai greeting Leo at the refreshment table has no bearing on Ben watching riders with a stopwatch.
Kai's greeting near the refreshment table is unrelated to the crowd's applause at the finish line.
The race beginning after the rules were read directly leads into cheers as cyclists sped off, supporting that event.
The race starting supports the later occurrence of spectators cheering on the final hill as the race progresses.
Cheers as cyclists sped off is consistent with and supports the idea that Ben was watching with a stopwatch, though not directly causal.
Cyclists speeding down the first stretch supports the later development that leaders passed the halfway marker by midday.
Ben's age relative to Ivo has no connection to organizers preparing for the awards ceremony.
Leaders passing the halfway marker supports the idea that Rosa is holding pace just behind the front group at a similar stage.
Leaders passing halfway supports the later scene of spectators cheering as cyclists approach the finish on the final hill.
Rosa holding pace behind the front group supports the scenario of cyclists pushing toward the finish amid cheering spectators.
Spectators cheering as cyclists approach the finish supports the crowd's applause when the last rider crosses the line.
The crowd applauding as the last rider finishes supports the organizers then beginning to prepare for the awards ceremony.
